provenance: Independent synthetic PCM_16 WAV holdout measured through librosa 0.11.0. Generated before evaluating rule-based-v5; excluded from the fixed timbre-reference fit. These are acoustic regression controls, not real songs or human music-color labels.

generator.aggregation: Whole-track duration average over active quarter-second features, with RMS quadratic mean; same summarize(frames, true) as buildMusicColors.
generator.processing: Fade each waveform with min(1,t/0.03,(2-t)/0.03), peak-normalize to 0.35, encode WAV, then decode and measure with the actual extractor.
